gini_definition: G = sum_i sum_j |x_i - x_j| / (2 n^2 mu), x_i = monthly net_pnl per calendar month (zero-filled span), mu = mean(x) > 0 (if mu <= 0 report null). Relative mean absolute difference; 0 = perfectly diffuse, ->1 = maximally concentrated.

method.month_key: calendar month YYYY-MM of exit_time in UTC
method.monthly_table: per calendar month: n_trades, n_wins, gross_pnl, fees, funding, net_pnl, cum_net
method.pnl_column: net_pnl summed per month (net of fees+funding as recorded in trades CSV)

method.trade_concentration: top1_trade_share = max(net_pnl)/total_net; top5_trades_share = sum(5 largest net_pnl)/total_net; worst5_drag = sum(5 smallest net_pnl)/total_net (context)
